keep.text: Lichaya is draining a neighbour: a parasite.
A brain grew a new neuron (Yafi). Brains are getting more complex.
Grisha and Yafi have formed a pod: they stay together and share food.
Kagri hurt its own relative Gune. Family betrayal.
Yafi and Grisha have become best friends.
Bobe fed a hungry relative (Gugri). Family care has begun.
Kagri shared energy with a neighbour: cooperation.
The first mating: two parents, one child, mixed brains.
Cannibalism! Kafi ate one of its own kind.
Pidecha mated with a close relative. The child is weak.
Sopi stocked a granary: hoarding has begun.
Zumofi and Nubota are a bonded pair with a child.
Year 1 in review: population 500, 16 species alive; 318 species born, 308 went extinct; 95128 births, 16976 kills, 286910 friendships; the Wucha Bloomers lead with 290; deepest line: generation 315.
